muslim:6762.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that the opening clause affirming birth upon the innate *fiṭrah* refutes the Christian doctrine of Original Sin, and that the exemption of Mary and Jesus merely echoes the maternal supplication in [Quran 3:36](quran://3/36) rather than granting Jesus an exclusive sinless status above Muhammad. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states *kullu insānin taliduhu ummuhu yalkuzuhu al-shayṭānu fī ḥiḍnayhi illā Maryama wa-ibnahā* ("Every human being whom his mother gives birth to, Satan punches him in his two sides, except Mary and her son"), applying the universal quantifier *kullu insānin* ("every human being") alongside the restrictive exception particle *illā* ("except"). By joining *fiṭrah* with a universal Satanic strike at birth from which only Mary and Jesus are exempted (`bukhari:3431`, `muslim:6133`, [Ibn Kathir 3:36](ibnkathir://3/36)), Muhammad places himself and all humanity under Satan's natal touch while conceding the unique, unblemished holiness of Christ ([Luke 1:35](bible://lk/1/35), [Hebrews 4:15](bible://heb/4/15)).

muslim:4285.note: Abu Huraira reports that Solomon vowed to go round to his sixty wives in a single night (*al-laylata*) so each would conceive a male horseman to fight in the cause of Allah, yet only one conceived and gave birth to 'half a human' (*niṣf insān*). Muhammad affirms the account by declaring that had Solomon made an exception (by saying *insha'Allah*), all sixty wives would have borne such horsemen, while the English translation alters *al-laylata* ('tonight') to 'every night' and renders *niṣf insān* as 'an incomplete child.'

problematic_excerpt.arabic: كَانَ لِسُلَيْمَانَ سِتُّونَ امْرَأَةً فَقَالَ لأَطُوفَنَّ عَلَيْهِنَّ اللَّيْلَةَ فَتَحْمِلُ كُلُّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْهُنَّ فَتَلِدُ كُلُّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْهُنَّ غُلاَمًا فَارِسًا يُقَاتِلُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَلَمْ تَحْمِلْ مِنْهُنَّ إِلاَّ وَاحِدَةٌ فَوَلَدَتْ نِصْفَ إِنْسَانٍ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَوْ كَانَ اسْتَثْنَى لَوَلَدَتْ كُلُّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْهُنَّ غُلاَمًا فَارِسًا يُقَاتِلُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"
problematic_excerpt.english: Abu Huraira reported that (Hadrat) Sulaiman had sixty wives. He (one day) said:I will visit each one of them every night, and every one of them will become pregnant and give birth to a male child who will be a horseman and fight in the cause of Allah. But (it so happened) that none of them became pregnant except one, but she gave birth to an incomplete child. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Had he said Insha' Allah (if God so wills), then every one of them would have given birth to a child who would have been a horseman and fought in the cause of Allah

muslim:4285.literal_translation: Abu Huraira reported that Sulaiman had sixty wives. He said: 'I will surely go round to [have intercourse with] all of them tonight, so that every one of them will become pregnant and give birth to a male horseman who fights in the way of Allah.' Yet none of them became pregnant except one, and she gave birth to half a human. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Had he made an exception [saying Insha'Allah], every one of them would have given birth to a male horseman who fights in the way of Allah.'

translation_issue.arabic_term: اللَّيْلَةَ ... نِصْفَ إِنْسَانٍ
translation_issue.published_rendering: every night ... an incomplete child
translation_issue.literal_meaning: tonight ... half a human
translation_issue.explanation: The translator alters 'al-laylata' ('tonight') to 'every night' to obscure the claim of cohabiting with sixty wives in a single night, and softens 'niṣf insān' ('half a human') to 'an incomplete child'.

muslim:4285.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that this account is merely a moral lesson on relying on Allah's will ([Quran 38:34](quran://38/34)), or appeal to softened English translations claiming Solomon visited his sixty wives 'every night' and that one bore 'an incomplete child.' However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states *la-aṭūfanna 'alayhinna al-laylata* ('I will surely go round to all of them tonight') and specifies that the single wife who conceived gave birth to *niṣf insān* ('half a human'). Moreover, Muhammad's concluding statement—that had Solomon made the exception (*insha'Allah*), every one of the sixty wives would have given birth to a male horseman—presents the narrative as a literal event in which sixty simultaneous conceptions failed solely due to an omitted verbal formula (see also `bukhari:5242`, `bukhari:3424`, and `muslim:4286`).

bukhari:5293.note: As reported by Zaynab, Muhammad declared that an opening had been breached in the barrier (radm) confining Gog and Magog, forming a circle in the shape of the number ninety with his fingers to illustrate the breach (cf. bukhari:3346; [Quran 18:96](quran://18/96); [Quran 21:96](quran://21/96)).

problematic_excerpt.arabic: وَقَالَتْ زَيْنَبُ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ فُتِحَ مِنْ رَدْمِ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مِثْلُ هَذِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَعَقَدَ تِسْعِينَ‏.‏
problematic_excerpt.english: Zainab said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "An opening has been made in the wall of Gog and Magog like this and this," forming the number 90 (with his thumb and index finger)

bukhari:5293.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that the breach in the barrier is a figurative metaphor (*majāz*) for impending political tribulations (*fitan*) or that the wall is supernaturally concealed from modern detection. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states that an opening was made in the physical *radm* (`فُتِحَ مِنْ رَدْمِ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مِثْلُ هَذِهِ`)—the exact terrestrial dam of iron blocks and molten copper built between two mountain cliffs in Quran 18:96—while Muhammad physically formed the number ninety with his fingers (`وَعَقَدَ تِسْعِينَ`) to show its literal aperture. Both Ibn Ḥajar (*Fatḥ al-Bārī*) and al-Nawawī (*Sharḥ Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim*) confirm that the orthodox position takes this breach literally (*ʿalā ẓāhirihi*) in an earthly barrier confining vast human tribes, leaving Islam committed to a 7th-century AD geographical myth that complete satellite mapping of the Earth has thoroughly falsified.

muslim:6147.note: Abu Huraira reports—in an account explicitly attributed to Muhammad in parallel narrations (muslim:6146, bukhari:278, bukhari:3404)—that the Israelites claimed Moses had a scrotal hernia because his modesty kept him from being seen naked. When Moses bathed and placed his garment on a stone, the stone ran off and he chased it, striking it with his staff (bi-'asahu) while crying, "My garment, O stone!" until it stopped before a gathering of Israelites, whereupon [Quran 33:69](quran://33/69) was revealed.

problematic_excerpt.arabic: كَانَ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ رَجُلاً حَيِيًّا - قَالَ - فَكَانَ لاَ يُرَى مُتَجَرِّدًا - قَالَ - فَقَالَ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ إِنَّهُ آدَرُ - قَالَ - فَاغْتَسَلَ عِنْدَ مُوَيْهٍ فَوَضَعَ ثَوْبَهُ عَلَى حَجَرٍ فَانْطَلَقَ الْحَجَرُ يَسْعَى وَاتَّبَعَهُ بِعَصَاهُ يَضْرِبُهُ ثَوْبِي حَجَرُ ثَوْبِي حَجَرُ ‏.‏ حَتَّى وَقَفَ عَلَى مَلإٍ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لاَ تَكُونُوا كَالَّذِينَ آذَوْا مُوسَى فَبَرَّأَهُ اللَّهُ مِمَّا قَالُوا وَكَانَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَجِيهًا‏}‏
problematic_excerpt.english: Abu Huraira reported that Moses was a modest person. He was never seen naked and Banu Isra'iI said:(He was afraid to expose his private part) because he had been suffering from scrotal hernia. He (one day) took bath in water and placed his garments upon a stone. The stone began to move on quickly. He followed that and struck it with the help of a stone (saying): O stone, my garment; O stone, my garments, O stone; until it stopped near the big gathering of Isrii'll, and this verse was revealed (pertaining to the incident):" O you who believe, be not Iike those who maligned Moses, but Allah cleared him of what they said, and he was worthy of regard with Allah" (xxxiii)

muslim:6147.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that the stone running away with Moses's garment was a dignified miracle designed to vindicate a prophet's honor against false accusations, or they attempt to distance the Quranic text from Abu Huraira's narrative. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states that [Quran 33:69](quran://33/69) was revealed (وَنَزَلَتْ) concerning this specific incident, directly tying the verse to the account of a fleeing stone (فَانْطَلَقَ الْحَجَرُ يَسْعَى) that Moses chased and beat with his staff (وَاتَّبَعَهُ بِعَصَاهُ يَضْرِبُهُ) while shouting, "My garment, O stone!" (ثَوْبِي حَجَرُ). Moreover, the narrative undermines its own premise of honoring Moses's modesty (كَانَ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ رَجُلاً حَيِيًّا) by forcing a prophet who was never seen naked (لاَ يُرَى مُتَجَرِّدًا) to pursue his clothes until he stood exposed before a public gathering of Israelites (عَلَى مَلإٍ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ) to disprove claims of a scrotal hernia (إِنَّهُ آدَرُ).

bukhari:3347.note: Muhammad declared that Allah had made an opening in the barrier (*radm*) confining Gog and Magog ([Quran 18:94-98](quran://18/94-98), [Quran 21:96](quran://21/96)), forming a circle with his fingers in the Arab gesture for the number ninety to illustrate the breach's size (cf. bukhari:3346, bukhari:7136).

problematic_excerpt.arabic: قَالَ ‏ "‏ فَتَحَ اللَّهُ مِنْ رَدْمِ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مِثْلَ هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَعَقَدَ بِيَدِهِ تِسْعِينَ‏.‏
problematic_excerpt.english: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has made an opening in the wall of the Gog and Magog (people) like this, and he made with his hand (with the help of his fingers)

bukhari:3347.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that the barrier of Gog and Magog is either a metaphor for geopolitical tribulations or a physical structure hidden by Allah in an unseen dimension beyond satellite detection. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states that Allah opened a literal breach in the physical dam (fataḥa Allāhu min radmi Ya'jūja wa Ma'jūja mithla hādhā), using the exact Quranic noun (radm, Quran 18:95–96) for an iron-and-copper wall built between two terrestrial mountains, while Muhammad formed the finger-reckoning circle for ninety (wa 'aqada bi-yadihi tis'īn) to illustrate the hole's actual size. Furthermore, parallel Sahih narrations (bukhari:3346, muslim:7373) confirm that classical commentators like Ibn Hajar in Fatḥ al-Bārī understood them as massive, earthbound human tribes who will physically drink the Sea of Galilee dry—a concrete geographical claim thoroughly falsified by modern cartography.

bukhari:3598.note: Muhammad entered upon Zaynab bint Jahsh in a state of alarm, warning of approaching evil for the Arabs and forming a circle with two fingers to show the size of a hole opened that day in the barrier (radm) of Gog and Magog ([Quran 18:94-97](quran://18/94-97)). When asked if they would be destroyed while righteous people remained among them, he affirmed they would if wickedness increased—a report classical commentators such as Ibn Hajar and al-Nawawi maintain primarily describes a literal breach in an earthly physical wall rather than a mere metaphor.

problematic_excerpt.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا فَزِعًا يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَيْلٌ لِلْعَرَبِ مِنْ شَرٍّ قَدِ اقْتَرَبَ، فُتِحَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ رَدْمِ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مِثْلُ هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَحَلَّقَ بِإِصْبَعِهِ وَبِالَّتِي تَلِيهَا، فَقَالَتْ زَيْنَبُ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَنَهْلِكُ وَفِينَا الصَّالِحُونَ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ، إِذَا كَثُرَ الْخَبَثُ ‏"‏
problematic_excerpt.english: That the Prophet (ﷺ) came to her in a state of fear saying, "None has the right to be worshiped but Allah! Woe to the Arabs because of evil that has come near. Today a hole has been made in the wall of Gog and Magog as large as this." pointing with two of his fingers making a circle. Zainab said, "I said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall we be destroyed though amongst us there are pious people? ' He said, 'Yes, if evil increases

bukhari:3598.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that the breach in the wall of Gog and Magog is merely a metaphorical idiom (*istiʿārah*) for approaching political turmoil (*fitan*), or that the barrier is supernaturally concealed from modern satellite detection. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states that a literal opening was made in the barrier (*futiḥa al-yawma min radmi Yaʾjūj wa-Maʾjūj*) whose physical size Muhammad demonstrated by forming a circle with his two fingers (*wa-ḥallaqa bi-iṣbaʿihi wa-bi-llatī talīhā*), directly invoking the tangible iron-and-copper rampart (*radm*) built between two mountain peaks in [Quran 18:95-97](quran://18/95-97). Indeed, Ibn Ḥajar in *Fatḥ al-Bārī* refuted Qāḍī ʿIyāḍ's metaphorical evasion by affirming a literal physical breach, leaving Islam tied to a 7th-century AD geographical fable that modern global exploration has completely falsified.

bukhari:7136.note: Muhammad declares that an opening has been made in the barrier (*radm*) of Gog and Magog ([Quran 18:94-98](quran://18/94-98)), with the narrator illustrating the size of the breach by forming a circle with his thumb and index finger (the Arabic finger-numeral for ninety). In the immediately preceding narration (bukhari:7135), Muhammad states that this breach was opened on that very day and warns of an approaching calamity for the Arabs.

problematic_excerpt.arabic: يُفْتَحُ الرَّدْمُ رَدْمُ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مِثْلَ هَذِهِ
problematic_excerpt.english: A hole has been opened in the dam of Gog and Magog.

bukhari:7136.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that the barrier of Gog and Magog is either a figurative metaphor for restraint, concealed in an unseen dimension (ghayb) undetectable by satellites, or—citing Ibn Hajar's Fatḥ al-Bārī—that the breach was merely a symbolic warning of approaching tribulations. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states that the physical dam (الرَّدْمُ رَدْمُ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ) was opened by a tangible, measurable gap (مِثْلَ هَذِهِ — demonstrated with a finger-circle representing the number ninety), directly referencing the literal wall of iron blocks and molten copper built between two earthly mountains (بَيْنَ الصَّدَفَيْنِ) in Surah 18:93–97. Complete satellite mapping of the Earth's surface proves that neither this massive metallurgical wall nor the vast terrestrial hordes supposedly trapped behind it since the 7th century AD exist anywhere in physical reality.

muslim:6148.note: In this narration (attributed in full to Muhammad in muslim:6149), when the Angel of Death is sent to Moses, Moses strikes the angel and knocks his eye out, prompting the angel to return to Allah and report that he was sent to a servant who did not want to die. Allah then restores the angel's eye and instructs him to offer Moses an additional year of life for every hair covered by his hand on the back of an ox, whereupon Moses chooses to die immediately after learning that death would still follow.

problematic_excerpt.arabic: أُرْسِلَ مَلَكُ الْمَوْتِ إِلَى مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُ صَكَّهُ فَفَقَأَ عَيْنَهُ فَرَجَعَ إِلَى رَبِّهِ فَقَالَ أَرْسَلْتَنِي إِلَى عَبْدٍ لاَ يُرِيدُ الْمَوْتَ - قَالَ - فَرَدَّ اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ عَيْنَهُ وَقَالَ ارْجِعْ إِلَيْهِ فَقُلْ لَهُ يَضَعُ يَدَهُ عَلَى مَتْنِ ثَوْرٍ فَلَهُ بِمَا غَطَّتْ يَدُهُ بِكُلِّ شَعْرَةٍ سَنَةٌ قَالَ أَىْ رَبِّ ثُمَّ مَهْ قَالَ ثُمَّ الْمَوْتُ ‏.‏
problematic_excerpt.english: Abu Huraira reported that the Angel of Death was sent to Moses (peace be upon him) to inform of his Lord's summons. When he came, he (Moses) boxed him and his eye was knocked out. He (the Angel of Death) came back to the Lord and said:You sent me to a servant. who did not want to die. Allah restored his eye to its proper place (and revived his eyesight), and then said: Go back to him and tell him that if he wants life he must place his hand on the back of an ox, and he would be granted as many years of life as the number of hair covered by his hand. He (Moses) said: My Lord what would happen then He said: Then you must court death.

muslim:6148.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that the Angel of Death appeared to Moses as an unrecognized human intruder, claiming Moses struck him in self-defense without knowing his identity, or that the blinding is merely metaphorical. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states that after Moses struck him and knocked out his eye (ṣakkahu fafaqaʾa ʿaynahu), the angel returned to Allah saying, 'You sent me to a servant who does not want to die' (arsaltanī ilā ʿabdin lā yurīdu al-mawta), and Allah restored his eye (faradda Allāhu ilayhi ʿaynahu). Furthermore, Allah's subsequent offer to grant Moses a year of life for every hair covered by his hand on the back of an ox (matni thawrin) confirms both the literal physical damage to the angel's eye and that Moses was resisting the summons to die rather than acting out of mistaken identity.

bukhari:7135.note: Entering in a state of fear, Muhammad warns of an approaching evil to the Arabs and declares that an opening the size of a circle formed by his thumb and index finger has been made that day in the barrier of Gog and Magog (bukhari:3346). While some commentators suggested the breach was a metaphor for the onset of tribulations, mainstream classical scholarship—as affirmed by Ibn Hajar—treats the barrier on earth and its physical opening literally.

problematic_excerpt.arabic: فُتِحَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ رَدْمِ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مِثْلُ هَذِهِ
problematic_excerpt.english: Today a hole has been opened in the dam of Gog and Magog like this.

bukhari:7135.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that Muhammad's statement was merely a metaphorical warning about approaching social tribulations, or that the barrier of Gog and Magog is miraculously concealed in an unseen dimension beyond modern satellite detection. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states that a physical hole was opened that day in the structural dam (فُتِحَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ رَدْمِ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مِثْلُ هَذِهِ), which Muhammad literally measured by forming a circle with his thumb and index finger (وَحَلَّقَ بِإِصْبَعَيْهِ الإِبْهَامِ وَالَّتِي تَلِيهَا). Furthermore, Ibn Hajar's Fatḥ al-Bārī and Al-Nawawī's Sharḥ Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim affirm the orthodox consensus that this dam (رَدْم) is the literal terrestrial wall of iron and molten copper built between two mountains in Qur'an 18:95–97—an apocalyptic legend borrowed from the 6th-century AD Syriac Alexander Romance.

bukhari:4800.note: Explaining [Quran 34:23](quran://34/23), Muhammad states that when Allah decrees an order in heaven, angels beat their wings to a sound like a chain on smooth rock while stealthy listeners (مُسْتَرِقُ السَّمْعِ, eavesdropping devils) stack one atop another to overhear a word and relay it down to a magician or soothsayer before or after a shooting star (الشِّهَابُ) overtakes them ([Quran 15:17-18](quran://15/17); [Quran 37:6-10](quran://37/6); [Quran 72:8-9](quran://72/8); bukhari:3210).

problematic_excerpt.arabic: إِذَا قَضَى اللَّهُ الأَمْرَ فِي السَّمَاءِ ضَرَبَتِ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ بِأَجْنِحَتِهَا خُضْعَانًا لِقَوْلِهِ كَأَنَّهُ سِلْسِلَةٌ عَلَى صَفْوَانٍ فَإِذَا فُزِّعَ عَنْ قُلُوبِهِمْ قَالُوا مَاذَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ، قَالُوا لِلَّذِي قَالَ الْحَقَّ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْكَبِيرُ فَيَسْمَعُهَا مُسْتَرِقُ السَّمْعِ، وَمُسْتَرِقُ السَّمْعِ هَكَذَا بَعْضُهُ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ ـ وَوَصَفَ سُفْيَانُ بِكَفِّهِ فَحَرَفَهَا وَبَدَّدَ بَيْنَ أَصَابِعِهِ ـ فَيَسْمَعُ الْكَلِمَةَ، فَيُلْقِيهَا إِلَى مَنْ تَحْتَهُ ثُمَّ يُلْقِيهَا الآخَرُ إِلَى مَنْ تَحْتَهُ، حَتَّى يُلْقِيَهَا عَلَى لِسَانِ السَّاحِرِ أَوِ الْكَاهِنِ، فَرُبَّمَا أَدْرَكَ الشِّهَابُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُلْقِيَهَا، وَرُبَّمَا أَلْقَاهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ يُدْرِكَهُ، فَيَكْذِبُ مَعَهَا مِائَةَ كَذْبَةٍ
problematic_excerpt.english: When Allah decrees some order in the heaven, the angels flutter their wings indicating complete surrender to His saying which sounds like chains being dragged on rock. And when the state of fear disappears, they ask each other, "What has your Lord ordered? They say that He has said that which is true and just, and He is the Most High, the Most Great." (34.23). Then the stealthy listeners (devils) hear this order, and these stealthy listeners are like this, one over the other." (Sufyan, a sub-narrator demonstrated that by holding his hand upright and separating the fingers.) A stealthy listener hears a word which he will convey to that which is below him and the second will convey it to that which is below him till the last of them will convey it to the wizard or foreteller. Sometimes a flame (fire) may strike the devil before he can convey it, and sometimes he may convey it before the flame (fire) strikes him, whereupon the wizard adds to that word a hundred lies.

bukhari:4800.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that this narration describes non-physical realities of the unseen realm (*ʿālam al-ghayb*), claiming that the stacking of jinn is metaphorical and that *al-shihāb* refers to unseen spiritual projectiles rather than physical astronomical meteors. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states that the eavesdroppers position themselves spatially atop one another (*hākadhā baʿḍuhu fawqa baʿḍ*)—physically demonstrated by Sufyān tilting his hand and spreading his fingers—to pass the overheard word downward (*ilā man taḥtahu*) before a pursuing flame (*al-shihāb*) physically overtakes them (*adraka al-shihāb*). Furthermore, [Quran 67:5](quran://67/5) and parallel Sahih narrations (muslim:5819) explicitly identify the visible lamps adorning the lowest heaven (*maṣābīḥ*) and the shooting stars observed by the Companions in the night sky (*rumiya bi-l-najm*) as the literal missiles (*rujūman lil-shayāṭīn*) flung at these devils.

muslim:7497.note: Abu Huraira states that the rat (*al-fa'rah*) is the result of metamorphosis (*maskh*), citing as proof (*ayah*) that it drinks goat's milk when placed before it while refusing to taste camel's milk. When Ka'b asks whether he heard this from Muhammad, Abu Huraira asks rhetorically whether the Torah was revealed to him, affirming that his source is Muhammad himself (`muslim:7496`, `bukhari:3305`).

problematic_excerpt.arabic: قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْفَأْرَةُ مَسْخٌ وَآيَةُ ذَلِكَ أَنَّهُ يُوضَعُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهَا لَبَنُ الْغَنَمِ فَتَشْرَبُهُ وَيُوضَعُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهَا لَبَنُ الإِبِلِ فَلاَ تَذُوقُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ كَعْبٌ أَسَمِعْتَ هَذَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ أَفَأُنْزِلَتْ عَلَىَّ التَّوْرَاةُ
problematic_excerpt.english: Abu Huraira reported that the rat (is the result of) metamorphosis (of a group of Bani Isra'il) and the proof of this is that when the milk of goat is placed before it, it drinks it, and when the milk of the camel is placed before it, it would not taste it at all. Ka'b said:Did you hear it from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? Thereupon he said: Has Torah been revealed to me?

muslim:7497.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that this report is merely Abu Huraira's personal opinion borrowed from Jewish folklore rather than a definitive prophetic teaching, or that it was only a figurative comparison. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states as a literal fact that "the rat is a metamorphosis (*al-fa'ratu maskh*)" and presents its refusal to taste camel's milk (*laban al-ibil*) while drinking goat's milk (*laban al-ghanam*) as "the proof of that (*wa-ayatu dhalika*)" in line with Israelite dietary prohibitions ([Leviticus 11:4](bible://lv/11/4)). Furthermore, when Ka'b questions whether he heard this from the Messenger of Allah, Abu Huraira replies, "Has the Torah been revealed to me? (*a-fa-unzilat 'alayya al-tawrah*)" to confirm that his source is Muhammad himself, matching the direct prophetic attributions in `bukhari:3305` and `muslim:7496`.

muslim:7497.note: Abu Huraira's report from Muhammad (`muslim:7496`, `bukhari:3305`) that the rat is the result of metamorphosis (*al-fa'ratu maskh*) contradicts the statement in `muslim:6771` and `muslim:6773` that no metamorphosed people (*maskh*) ever produced offspring or surviving descendants. The narration cites the ongoing behavior of living rats drinking goat's milk while refusing camel's milk as the proof (*ayah*) of their metamorphosis, and Abu Huraira continued transmitting it to Ka'b on Muhammad's authority rather than treating it as an abrogated conjecture.

problematic_excerpt.arabic: قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْفَأْرَةُ مَسْخٌ وَآيَةُ ذَلِكَ أَنَّهُ يُوضَعُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهَا لَبَنُ الْغَنَمِ فَتَشْرَبُهُ وَيُوضَعُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهَا لَبَنُ الإِبِلِ فَلاَ تَذُوقُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ كَعْبٌ أَسَمِعْتَ هَذَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ أَفَأُنْزِلَتْ عَلَىَّ التَّوْرَاةُ
problematic_excerpt.english: Abu Huraira reported that the rat (is the result of) metamorphosis (of a group of Bani Isra'il) and the proof of this is that when the milk of goat is placed before it, it drinks it, and when the milk of the camel is placed before it, it would not taste it at all. Ka'b said:Did you hear it from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? Thereupon he said: Has Torah been revealed to me?

muslim:7497.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that this statement was only a tentative supposition made before it was revealed in `muslim:6771` and `muslim:6773` that metamorphosed humans (*maskh*) never produce offspring, thereby resolving the contradiction through abrogation. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states in categorical terms that "the rat is a metamorphosis (*al-fa'ratu maskh*)" and cites the dietary behavior of living rats toward goat's milk (*laban al-ghanam*) and camel's milk (*laban al-ibil*) as active empirical proof (*wa-ayatu dhalika*). Moreover, Abu Huraira continues to teach this literal claim by invoking the Messenger of Allah's direct authority against Ka'b's skepticism, leaving a direct contradiction between living rats being metamorphosed Israelites (`bukhari:3305`, `muslim:7496`) and metamorphosed people leaving no surviving descendants (`muslim:6771`, `muslim:6773`).

bukhari:3431.note: Muhammad declares that every human newborn cries loudly at birth because Satan touches them, exempting only Mary and her son Jesus—an exemption Abu Huraira links to [Quran 3:36](quran://3/36), while parallel reports specify that Satan pokes the infant with his fingers (bukhari:3286).

problematic_excerpt.arabic: مَا مِنْ بَنِي آدَمَ مَوْلُودٌ إِلاَّ يَمَسُّهُ الشَّيْطَانُ حِينَ يُولَدُ، فَيَسْتَهِلُّ صَارِخًا مِنْ مَسِّ الشَّيْطَانِ، غَيْرَ مَرْيَمَ وَابْنِهَا
problematic_excerpt.english: There is none born among the off-spring of Adam, but Satan touches it. A child therefore, cries loudly at the time of birth because of the touch of Satan, except Mary and her child.

bukhari:3431.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that the 'touch of Satan' (mass al-shayṭān) is merely a metaphor for humanity's worldly exposure to temptation rather than a physical cause for a newborn's cry, and cite commentators like al-Nawawī to claim that all prophets shared this immunity. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states فَيَسْتَهِلُّ صَارِخًا مِنْ مَسِّ الشَّيْطَانِ ('so it cries out loudly from the touch of Satan'), directly attributing a universal neonatal respiratory reflex to demonic contact, while parallel Sahih narrations (bukhari:3286, muslim:6133) specify that Satan physically pokes the infant's sides with his fingers (يَطْعُنُ الشَّيْطَانُ فِي جَنْبَيْهِ بِأُصْبُعِهِ) and tried to stab Jesus at birth but only struck the veil (الْحِجَابَ). Furthermore, the categorical exception غَيْرَ مَرْيَمَ وَابْنِهَا ('except Mary and her son') strictly limits this protection to Jesus and Mary alone, conceding that even Muhammad was pricked by Satan at birth while Jesus Christ remained uniquely untouchable.

muslim:5511.note: When Gabriel does not arrive at his promised hour—prompting Muhammad to throw down his staff and declare that neither Allah nor His messengers break their promises—Muhammad finds a puppy under his cot that had entered without A'isha's knowledge and orders it removed. Gabriel then arrives and states that the dog in the house prevented him from coming, because angels do not enter a house containing a dog or a picture.

problematic_excerpt.arabic: وَاعَدَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جِبْرِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ فِي سَاعَةٍ يَأْتِيهِ فِيهَا فَجَاءَتْ تِلْكَ السَّاعَةُ وَلَمْ يَأْتِهِ وَفِي يَدِهِ عَصًا فَأَلْقَاهَا مِنْ يَدِهِ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا يُخْلِفُ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ وَلاَ رُسُلُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ الْتَفَتَ فَإِذَا جِرْوُ كَلْبٍ تَحْتَ سَرِيرِهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا عَائِشَةُ مَتَى دَخَلَ هَذَا الْكَلْبُ هَا هُنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ وَاللَّهِ مَا دَرَيْتُ ‏.‏ فَأَمَرَ بِهِ فَأُخْرِجَ فَجَاءَ جِبْرِيلُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَاعَدْتَنِي فَجَلَسْتُ لَكَ فَلَمْ تَأْتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ مَنَعَنِي الْكَلْبُ الَّذِي كَانَ فِي بَيْتِكَ إِنَّا لاَ نَدْخُلُ بَيْتًا فِيهِ كَلْبٌ وَلاَ صُورَةٌ ‏.‏
problematic_excerpt.english: A'isha reported that Gabriel (peace be upon him) made a promise with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to come at a definite hour; that hour came but he did not visit him. And there was in his hand (in the hand of Allah's Apostle) a staff. He threw it from his hand and said:Never has Allah or His messengers (angels) ever broken their promise. Then he cast a glance (and by chance) found a puppy under his cot and said: 'A'isha, when did this dog enter here? She said: By Allah, I don't know He then commanded and it was turned out. Then Gabriel came and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: You promised me and I waited for you, but you did not come, whereupon he said: It was the dog in your house which prevented me (to come), for we (angels) do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a picture

muslim:5511.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that this restriction applies only to angels of general mercy rather than revelation, or that it merely encourages household hygiene where dogs are intentionally kept. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states that Gabriel himself failed to arrive at the appointed hour (فَجَاءَتْ تِلْكَ السَّاعَةُ وَلَمْ يَأْتِهِ) and told Muhammad, "The dog that was in your house prevented me, for we do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a picture" (مَنَعَنِي الْكَلْبُ الَّذِي كَانَ فِي بَيْتِكَ إِنَّا لاَ نَدْخُلُ بَيْتًا فِيهِ كَلْبٌ وَلاَ صُورَةٌ). Because A'isha swore she did not even know when the puppy (جِرْوُ كَلْبٍ) had wandered under the cot (وَاللَّهِ مَا دَرَيْتُ), the narration portrays an unnoticed animal as capable of blocking Gabriel from fulfilling his promised appointment (وَاعَدْتَنِي فَجَلَسْتُ لَكَ فَلَمْ تَأْتِ).

bukhari:4548.note: Muhammad declares that every newborn cries loudly at birth because Satan touches it (`yamassuhu`), exempting only Mary and her son Jesus ([Quran 3:36](quran://3/36)). Orthodox Sunni commentators such as Ibn Hajar and Al-Nawawi affirm this as a literal physical contact by Satan causing the neonatal crying reflex, rejecting Mu'tazilite attempts to allegorize the text.

problematic_excerpt.arabic: مَا مِنْ مَوْلُودٍ يُولَدُ إِلاَّ وَالشَّيْطَانُ يَمَسُّهُ حِينَ يُولَدُ، فَيَسْتَهِلُّ صَارِخًا مِنْ مَسِّ الشَّيْطَانِ إِيَّاهُ، إِلاَّ مَرْيَمَ وَابْنَهَا
problematic_excerpt.english: No child is born but that, Satan touches it when it is born whereupon it starts crying loudly because of being touched by Satan, except Mary and her son.

bukhari:4548.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue, citing Muʿtazilite-influenced readings and modern figurative reinterpretations mentioned in Ibn Ḥajar's *Fatḥ al-Bārī*, that Satan's touch is merely a metaphor for his future temptation (*ighwāʾ*) of humanity rather than the physical cause of an infant's birth cry. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states a direct physical causation at the exact moment of delivery—*yamassuhu ḥīna yūladu fa-yastahillu ṣārikhan min massi al-shayṭāni iyyāhu* ('he touches it when it is born, whereupon it starts crying loudly because of Satan's touch')—and parallel authentic narrations (muslim:6135) specify that Satan physically pokes the newborn in the side (*fī al-khāṣirah*).

bukhari:4548.category: Christian Doctrines Muslims Attack That Are Conceded in Hadith
bukhari:4548.subcategory: Uncreated Divine Word, Original Sin & Sacramental Relics (Trinitarian & Soteriological Precedents)
bukhari:4548.note: Muhammad declares that every newborn child is touched by Satan at birth (`yamassuhu`), explicitly exempting only Mary and her son Jesus (`illā Maryama wa-bnahā`) ([Luke 1:35](bible://lk/1/35), [Hebrews 4:15](bible://heb/4/15), [Ibn Kathir 3:36](ibnkathir://3/36)). While Islamic theology rejects Original Sin ([Psalm 51:5](bible://ps/51/5), [Romans 5:12](bible://rom/5/12)) and asserts the sinlessness of all prophets, the text's exclusive exception singles out Jesus and Mary alone without exempting Muhammad.

problematic_excerpt.arabic: مَا مِنْ مَوْلُودٍ يُولَدُ إِلاَّ وَالشَّيْطَانُ يَمَسُّهُ حِينَ يُولَدُ، فَيَسْتَهِلُّ صَارِخًا مِنْ مَسِّ الشَّيْطَانِ إِيَّاهُ، إِلاَّ مَرْيَمَ وَابْنَهَا
problematic_excerpt.english: No child is born but that, Satan touches it when it is born whereupon it starts crying loudly because of being touched by Satan, except Mary and her son.

bukhari:4548.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue, citing Al-Qāḍī ʿIyāḍ in Al-Nawawī's *Sharḥ Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim* and Ibn Ḥajar's *Fatḥ al-Bārī*, that Muhammad and the other prophets shared in this exemption by analogy, or that Satan's touch at birth carried no spiritual consequence alongside the later removal of Satan's portion from Muhammad's heart. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states an absolute universal rule with an exclusive grammatical restriction—*mā min mawlūdin yūladu... illā Maryama wa-ibnahā* ('No child is born... except Mary and her son')—while Sahih Muslim (muslim:413) confirms that Gabriel had to surgically extract a physical black clot from Muhammad's chest in childhood while declaring, 'This was the portion of Satan in you' (*hādhā ḥaẓẓu al-shayṭāni minka*), leaving Jesus alone uniquely sinless and untainted from conception.

muslim:5840.note: When a snake is found under Abu Sa'id al-Khudri's bed, Muhammad's ruling is cited declaring that houses are inhabited by resident jinn-snakes (*'awāmir*, rendered in the published translation as 'aged (snakes)') and commanding Muslims to verbally adjure (*fa-ḥarrijū 'alayhā*) a house snake three times (for three days), killing it only if it fails to depart because 'it is an unbeliever' (*fa-innahu kāfir*). As the immediately following narration (muslim:5841) clarifies from the same chain, this verbal warning was instituted because resident jinn in Medina had converted to Islam, whereas a snake that refuses to leave after the warning is deemed an unbeliever.

problematic_excerpt.arabic: وَقَالَ فِيهِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ لِهَذِهِ الْبُيُوتِ عَوَامِرَ فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُمْ شَيْئًا مِنْهَا فَحَرِّجُوا عَلَيْهَا ثَلاَثًا فَإِنْ ذَهَبَ وَإِلاَّ فَاقْتُلُوهُ فَإِنَّهُ كَافِرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ لَهُمُ ‏"‏ اذْهَبُوا فَادْفِنُوا صَاحِبَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
problematic_excerpt.english: And in this Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is reported to have said: Verily in these houses there live aged (snakes), so when you see one of them, make life hard for it for three days, and if it goes away (well and good), otherwise kill it for (in that case) it would be a nonbeliever. And he (the Holy Prophet) said (to his Companions): Go and bury your companion (who had died by the snake bite)

muslim:5840.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that this instruction merely advises driving away "aged (snakes)" by making "life hard for it," or that it addresses unseen spiritual beings rather than physical reptiles. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states that houses are inhabited by resident jinn-snakes (*'awāmir*) that must be given a three-fold verbal adjuration (*fa-ḥarrijū 'alayhā thalāthan*), ordering Muslims to kill the reptile if it refuses to leave because "it is an unbeliever" (*fa-innahu kāfir*). Because Muhammad issues this ruling in direct response to a companion dying from a snake bite ("Go and bury your companion"), the text confirms that Muslims are instructed to verbally warn literal, venomous snakes for three days to test their religious belief.

muslim:4020.note: Muhammad initially ordered the killing of all dogs—such that his followers killed even the dog of a woman arriving from the desert—before forbidding their general killing while commanding his followers to kill every pure jet-black dog with two spots because 'it is a devil.'

problematic_excerpt.arabic: أَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِقَتْلِ الْكِلاَبِ حَتَّى إِنَّ الْمَرْأَةَ تَقْدَمُ مِنَ الْبَادِيَةِ بِكَلْبِهَا فَنَقْتُلُهُ ثُمَّ نَهَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ قَتْلِهَا وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ عَلَيْكُمْ بِالأَسْوَدِ الْبَهِيمِ ذِي النُّقْطَتَيْنِ فَإِنَّهُ شَيْطَانٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
problematic_excerpt.english: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered us to kill dogs, and we carried out this order so much so that we also kill the dog coming with a woman from the desert. Then Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade their killing. He (the Prophet further) said: It is your duty the jet-black (dog) having two spots (on the eyes), for it is a devil

muslim:4020.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that the command to kill dogs was a temporary public health measure against rabid animals that was later abrogated, and that the word shayṭān ('devil') is merely a metaphor for a vicious or rebellious animal. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states that the companions killed even a woman's accompanied dog arriving from the desert (taqdamu min al-bādiyati bi-kalbihā fa-naqtuluhu), and that after forbidding the general slaughter, Muhammad still commanded them to kill every pure jet-black dog with two spots (ʿalaykum bi-l-aswadi al-bahīmi dhī al-nuqṭatayni). Because this permanent command targets the animal strictly by its coat color and facial markings with the causal clause fa-innahu shayṭān ('for it is a devil'), the text mandates killing based on demonology rather than disease or aggression.

muslim:5839.note: When a visitor moves to kill a snake in his house, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri stops him and recounts how a young companion speared a large snake coiled on his bed and died alongside it. In response to that incident, Muhammad declared that there are jinns in Medina who have accepted Islam and commanded his followers to issue a three-day warning upon seeing one before killing it as a devil.

problematic_excerpt.arabic: فَدَخَلَ فَإِذَا بِحَيَّةٍ عَظِيمَةٍ مُنْطَوِيَةٍ عَلَى الْفِرَاشِ فَأَهْوَى إِلَيْهَا بِالرُّمْحِ فَانْتَظَمَهَا بِهِ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ فَرَكَزَهُ فِي الدَّارِ فَاضْطَرَبَتْ عَلَيْهِ فَمَا يُدْرَى أَيُّهُمَا كَانَ أَسْرَعَ مَوْتًا الْحَيَّةُ أَمِ الْفَتَى قَالَ فَجِئْنَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرْنَا ذَلِكَ لَهُ وَقُلْنَا ادْعُ اللَّهَ يُحْيِيهِ لَنَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اسْتَغْفِرُوا لِصَاحِبِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ بِالْمَدِينَةِ جِنًّا قَدْ أَسْلَمُوا فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُمْ مِنْهُمْ شَيْئًا فَآذِنُوهُ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ فَإِنْ بَدَا لَكُمْ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَاقْتُلُوهُ فَإِنَّمَا هُوَ شَيْطَانٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
problematic_excerpt.english: He entered and found a big snake coiled on the bedding. He darted with the spear and pierced it and then went out having fixed it in the house, but the snake quivered and attacked him and no one knew which of them died first, the snake or the young man. We came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and made a mention to him and said: Supplicate to Allah that that (man) may be brought back to life. Thereupon he said: Ask forgiveness for your companion and then said: There are in Medina jinns who have accepted Islam, so when you see any one of them, pronounce a warning to it for three days, and if they appear before you after that, then kill it for that is a devil

muslim:5839.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that the command to warn house-snakes is a metaphorical lesson on showing caution toward animals or an allegory about the unseen realm rather than a literal rule concerning physical reptiles. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states that when Abu as-Sa'ib rose to kill a physical snake (حَيَّةٌ) rustling in the wood bundles inside Abu Sa'id al-Khudri's house, Abu Sa'id stopped him by invoking Muhammad's binding legal command: "There are in Medina jinns who have accepted Islam (إِنَّ بِالْمَدِينَةِ جِنًّا قَدْ أَسْلَمُوا), so when you see any one of them, pronounce a warning to it for three days (فَآذِنُوهُ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ), and if they appear before you after that, then kill it for that is a devil (فَاقْتُلُوهُ فَإِنَّمَا هُوَ شَيْطَانٌ)." Furthermore, Muhammad issued this directive in direct response to a companion dying after spearing a large snake (حَيَّةٍ عَظِيمَةٍ) coiled on his bedding (مُنْطَوِيَةٍ عَلَى الْفِرَاشِ), showing that Muhammad and his companions treated physical snakes inside homes as literal Muslim jinns or devils that must be verbally warned for three days.

muslim:7235.note: Muhammad wakes from sleep declaring woe to the Arabs from an approaching evil because an opening—illustrated by the narrator Sufyan forming the hand-sign for ten—was made that very day (al-yawma) in the barrier of Gog and Magog ([Quran 18:94](quran://18/94)). When Zainab bint Jahsh asks whether they will be destroyed while righteous people remain among them, he affirms that they will when evil becomes abundant.

problematic_excerpt.arabic: عَنْ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ جَحْشٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم اسْتَيْقَظَ مِنْ نَوْمِهِ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَيْلٌ لِلْعَرَبِ مِنْ شَرٍّ قَدِ اقْتَرَبَ فُتِحَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ رَدْمِ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مِثْلُ هَذِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَعَقَدَ سُفْيَانُ بِيَدِهِ عَشَرَةً ‏.‏ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَنَهْلِكُ وَفِينَا الصَّالِحُونَ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ إِذَا كَثُرَ الْخَبَثُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
problematic_excerpt.english: Zainab bint Jahsh reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) got up from sleep saying:There is no being worthy of worship except Allah; there is a destruction in store for Arabia because of turmoil which is at hand, the barrier of Gog and Magog has opened so much. And Sufyan made a sign of ten with the help of his hand (in order to indicate the width of the gap) and I said: Allah's Messenger, would we be perished in spite of the fact that there would be good people amongst us? Thereupon he said: Of course, but only when the evil predominates

muslim:7235.literal_translation: From Zainab bint Jahsh, that the Prophet woke from his sleep saying: 'There is no god but Allah; woe to the Arabs from an evil that has drawn near! Today an opening like this has been made in the barrier of Gog and Magog.' And Sufyan formed ten with his hand. I said: 'O Messenger of Allah, shall we be destroyed while the righteous are among us?' He said: 'Yes, when evil becomes abundant.'

translation_issue.arabic_term: فُتِحَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ رَدْمِ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مِثْلُ هَذِهِ
translation_issue.published_rendering: the barrier of Gog and Magog has opened so much
translation_issue.literal_meaning: Today an opening like this has been made in the barrier of Gog and Magog
translation_issue.explanation: The published translation omits the temporal noun 'al-yawma' ('today'), which specifies in the Arabic text that the opening in the barrier of Gog and Magog occurred on that very day.

muslim:7235.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that the opening in the barrier of Gog and Magog is a figurative metaphor for the spread of moral corruption and political turmoil rather than a literal physical breach. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states *futiḥa al-yawma min radmi Yaʾjūja wa-Maʾjūja mithlu hādhihi* ("Today an opening like this has been made in the barrier of Gog and Magog"), accompanied by the narrator forming a sign of ten with his hand to indicate the physical width of the gap. By declaring that the barrier of [Quran 18:94](quran://18/94) was breached on that very day (*al-yawma*) in the seventh century AD and warning of an evil for Arabia that had already drawn near (*qad iqtaraba*), the narration describes a literal physical structure and an imminent crisis rather than a distant allegory.

muslim:5044.note: When a Bedouin reports that lizards are his family's common diet, Muhammad replies after the third inquiry that Allah cursed or was wrathful with a tribe of the Children of Israel and metamorphosed (*masakhahum*) them into crawling beasts on the earth, stating that because he does not know whether lizards are among them, he neither eats them nor prohibits eating them (muslim:5041, muslim:5043, bukhari:3305).

problematic_excerpt.arabic: ثُمَّ نَادَاهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الثَّالِثَةِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَا أَعْرَابِيُّ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَعَنَ أَوْ غَضِبَ عَلَى سِبْطٍ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ فَمَسَخَهُمْ دَوَابَّ يَدِبُّونَ فِي الأَرْضِ فَلاَ أَدْرِي لَعَلَّ هَذَا مِنْهَا فَلَسْتُ آكُلُهَا وَلاَ أَنْهَى عَنْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
problematic_excerpt.english: Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called him out at the third time saying: O man of the desert, verily Allah cursed or showed wrath to a tribe of Bani Isra'il and distorted them to beasts which move on the earth. I do not know, perhaps this (lizard) may be one of them. So I do not eat it, nor do I prohibit the eating of it

muslim:5044.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that the transformation of Israelites in [Quran 2:65](quran://2/65) and [Quran 7:166](quran://7/166) was merely a metaphorical moral degradation, or that Muhammad was only expressing a personal dietary preference rather than affirming a physical mutation. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states *famasakhahum dawābba yadibbūna fī al-arḍi falā adrī laʿalla hādhā minhā* ("and metamorphosed them into crawling beasts that creep upon the earth; so I do not know, perhaps this is one of them"), directly grounding his refusal to eat the lizard (*falastu ākuluhā*) in the possibility that the reptile was from that cursed Israelite tribe (*sibṭin min Banī Isrāʾīl*). By stating that he did not know (*falā adrī*) whether the desert lizard was among those transformed Israelites, Muhammad treated the physical metamorphosis (*maskh*) of humans into creeping animals as a literal biological reality (cf. muslim:5041, muslim:5043, bukhari:3305).

muslim:5826.note: Muhammad commands the killing of snakes and dogs, specifically ordering the killing of two-striped and short-tailed snakes because they snatch away eyesight and cause pregnant women to miscarry, an effect the sub-narrator Al-Zuhri speculates is due to their venom. When Ibn Umar subsequently pursues a house snake to kill it, Zayd ibn al-Khattab or Abu Lubaba stops him and informs him that Muhammad forbade killing snakes that inhabit houses.

problematic_excerpt.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْمُرُ بِقَتْلِ الْكِلاَبِ يَقُولُ ‏\"‏ اقْتُلُوا الْحَيَّاتِ وَالْكِلاَبَ وَاقْتُلُوا ذَا الطُّفْيَتَيْنِ وَالأَبْتَرَ فَإِنَّهُمَا يَلْتَمِسَانِ الْبَصَرَ وَيَسْتَسْقِطَانِ الْحَبَالَى ‏\"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ وَنُرَى ذَلِكَ مِنْ سُمَّيْهِمَا وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ ‏.‏ قَالَ سَالِمٌ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ فَلَبِثْتُ لاَ أَتْرُكُ حَيَّةً أَرَاهَا إِلاَّ قَتَلْتُهَا فَبَيْنَا أَنَا أُطَارِدُ حَيَّةً يَوْمًا مِنْ ذَوَاتِ الْبُيُوتِ مَرَّ بِي زَيْدُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ أَوْ أَبُو لُبَابَةَ وَأَنَا أُطَارِدُهَا فَقَالَ مَهْلاً يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَ بِقَتْلِهِنَّ ‏.‏ قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ نَهَى عَنْ ذَوَاتِ الْبُيُوتِ
problematic_excerpt.english: Ibn 'Umar reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanding the killing of dogs and the killing of the striped and the short-tailed snakes, for both of them affect the eyesight adversely and cause miscarriage. Zuhri said: We thought of their poison (the pernicious effects of these two). Allah, however, knows best. 'Abdullah b. 'Umar said: I did not spare any snake. I rather killed everyone that I saw. One day as I was pursuing a snake from amongst the snakes of the house, Zaid b. Khattab or Abu Lubaba happened to pass by me and found me pursuing it. He said: 'Abdullah, wait. I said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded (us) to kill them, whereupon he said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the killing of the snakes of the houses.

muslim:5826.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that this command was a practical public-health measure against dangerous animals, appealing to al-Zuhri's remark in the narration to claim that the warnings about blindness and miscarriage describe the biological effects of snake venom. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states a general command to kill snakes and dogs (اقْتُلُوا الْحَيَّاتِ وَالْكِلاَبَ) and attributes the power to snatch away eyesight and cause pregnant women to miscarry (يَلْتَمِسَانِ الْبَصَرَ وَيَسْتَسْقِطَانِ الْحَبَالَى) specifically to two-striped and short-tailed snakes (ذَا الطُّفْيَتَيْنِ وَالأَبْتَرَ), whereas al-Zuhri's statement (وَنُرَى ذَلِكَ مِنْ سُمَّيْهِمَا وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ, 'We think that is from their poison, though Allah knows best') is a later narrator's conjecture rather than Muhammad's words. Furthermore, the report that Ibn 'Umar killed every snake he saw until Zaid b. al-Khattab or Abu Lubaba informed him that Muhammad forbade killing house snakes (نَهَى عَنْ ذَوَاتِ الْبُيُوتِ)—paralleled in bukhari:3297 and muslim:5833—demonstrates that these rulings were governed by folkloric distinctions rather than medical toxicology.

bukhari:3272.note: Muhammad prohibits praying while the sun is rising or setting, declaring that the sun rises between the two horns of Satan (qarnay shayṭān)—a phrase the English translation renders as 'two sides of the head of the devil.'

problematic_excerpt.arabic: إِذَا طَلَعَ حَاجِبُ الشَّمْسِ فَدَعُوا الصَّلاَةَ حَتَّى تَبْرُزَ، وَإِذَا غَابَ حَاجِبُ الشَّمْسِ فَدَعُوا الصَّلاَةَ حَتَّى تَغِيبَ ‏"‏‏.‏ ‏"‏ وَلاَ تَحَيَّنُوا بِصَلاَتِكُمْ طُلُوعَ الشَّمْسِ وَلاَ غُرُوبَهَا، فَإِنَّهَا تَطْلُعُ بَيْنَ قَرْنَىْ شَيْطَانٍ
problematic_excerpt.english: When the (upper) edge of the sun appears (in the morning), don't perform a prayer till the sun appears in full, and when the lower edge of the sun sets, don't perform a prayer till it sets completely. And you should not seek to pray at sunrise or sunset for the sun rises between two sides of the head of the devil (or Satan)

bukhari:3272.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that the phrase 'between the two horns of Satan' is merely a figure of speech referring to the times when pagan sun-worshippers prostrate at Satan's prompting, rather than a literal cosmological claim. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states *fa-innahā taṭluʿu bayna qarnay shayṭān* ('for indeed it rises between the two horns of Satan') in direct relation to the sun's physical rim (*ḥājib al-shams*), and both Al-Nawawī (*Sharḥ Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim*) and Ibn Ḥajar (*Fatḥ al-Bārī*) affirm that the literal interpretation (*ʿalā ẓāhirihi*) is the standard orthodox view—namely, that Satan physically stations his horned head in alignment with the rising and setting sun so that idolaters bow directly to him.

muslim:5043.note: When asked for a legal verdict on eating lizards in a lizard-abounding land, Muhammad replies, "It was mentioned to me that a nation from the Children of Israel was metamorphosed (*musikhat*)," and consequently neither commands nor forbids eating them ([Quran 2:65](quran://2/65), [Quran 7:166](quran://7/166); bukhari:3305, muslim:5041). Umar later remarks that the meat benefits many as the common food of shepherds and that Muhammad merely found it personally distasteful.

problematic_excerpt.arabic: قَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا بِأَرْضٍ مَضَبَّةٍ فَمَا تَأْمُرُنَا أَوْ فَمَا تُفْتِينَا قَالَ ‏ "‏ ذُكِرَ لِي أَنَّ أُمَّةً مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مُسِخَتْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمْ يَأْمُرْ وَلَمْ يَنْهَ ‏.‏
problematic_excerpt.english: a person said:Messenger of Allah, we live in a land abounding in lizards, so what do you command or what verdict you give (about eating of it)? Thereupon he said: It was mentioned to me that a people from among Bani Isra'il were distorted (so there is a likelihood that those people might have been distorted in the shape of lizards). So he neither commanded (us to eat that) nor forbade (us).

muslim:5043.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that Muhammad merely had a personal culinary distaste for lizards—citing Umar's concluding remark that 'Allah's Messenger disliked it' (*innamā 'āfahu rasūlu llāh*)—or that he spoke cautiously before revelation clarified that metamorphosed humans leave no offspring. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states that when asked for a formal command or legal verdict (*fa-mā ta'murunā aw fa-mā tuftīnā*), Muhammad answered, 'It was mentioned to me that a nation from the Children of Israel was metamorphosed' (*dhukira lī anna ummatan min Banī Isrā'īl musikhat*), and therefore 'neither commanded nor forbade' (*fa-lam ya'mur wa-lam yanha*). Suspending a prophetic legal ruling on the premise that wild lizards might be mutated Israelites ([Quran 2:65](quran://2/65), [Quran 7:166](quran://7/166)), as corroborated in `muslim:5041`, `muslim:5044`, and `bukhari:3305`, grounds his hesitation in folklore about human-to-animal metamorphosis rather than simple dietary preference.

bukhari:3273.note: Muhammad prohibits offering prayer while the sun is rising or setting, declaring that the sun rises between the two horns of Satan (qarnay shayṭān). Classical commentators affirm the literal meaning of this statement, explaining that Satan positions his head in front of the rising sun to intercept the prostrations of sun-worshippers.

problematic_excerpt.arabic: إِذَا طَلَعَ حَاجِبُ الشَّمْسِ فَدَعُوا الصَّلاَةَ حَتَّى تَبْرُزَ، وَإِذَا غَابَ حَاجِبُ الشَّمْسِ فَدَعُوا الصَّلاَةَ حَتَّى تَغِيبَ ‏"‏‏.‏ ‏"‏ وَلاَ تَحَيَّنُوا بِصَلاَتِكُمْ طُلُوعَ الشَّمْسِ وَلاَ غُرُوبَهَا، فَإِنَّهَا تَطْلُعُ بَيْنَ قَرْنَىْ شَيْطَانٍ
problematic_excerpt.english: When the (upper) edge of the sun appears (in the morning), don't perform a prayer till the sun appears in full, and when the lower edge of the sun sets, don't perform a prayer till it sets completely. And you should not seek to pray at sunrise or sunset for the sun rises between two sides of the head of the devil (or Satan)

bukhari:3273.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that 'the two horns of Satan' (qarnay shayṭān) is either a figurative metaphor for the timing of pagan sun-worshippers or an unseen spiritual reality (ghayb) where Satan intercepts their prostrations. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states that the sun itself 'rises between the two horns of Satan' (taṭluʿu bayna qarnay shayṭān), and classical authorities like Al-Nawawī (Sharḥ Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim) and Ibn Hajar (Fatḥ al-Bārī) affirm that the literal meaning (ʿalā ẓāhirihi)—Satan physically positioning his horned head in front of the rising sun—is the primary orthodox view. Moreover, this myth presupposes a pre-scientific flat-earth horizon with a single daily sunrise and sunset, whereas on a spherical Earth the sun is continuously rising and setting, which would absurdly require Satan's head to perpetually track the horizon around the globe.

muslim:5041.note: When presented with a spiny-tailed lizard (*ḍabb*), Muhammad refuses to eat it, stating that he does not know whether it belongs to the bygone generations that were physically metamorphosed (*musikhat*). While parallel reports record that he did not forbid others from eating the lizard (muslim:5039, muslim:5042), they likewise preserve his statement that a generation of the Children of Israel was metamorphosed into animals (muslim:5043).

problematic_excerpt.arabic: أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِضَبٍّ فَأَبَى أَنْ يَأْكُلَ مِنْهُ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ أَدْرِي لَعَلَّهُ مِنَ الْقُرُونِ الَّتِي مُسِخَتْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
problematic_excerpt.english: there was presented to Allah's Messenger (the flesh) of the lizard, but he refused to eat that, saying:I do not know; perhaps it (lizard) might (be one of those natives of) the distant past whose (forms) had beer, distorted

muslim:5041.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that Muhammad merely expressed personal distaste for an unfamiliar dish or spoke before receiving revelation that metamorphosed humans do not leave offspring. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states that he refused the lizard (*ḍabb*) because he feared it belonged to the ancient human generations physically metamorphosed into animals (*min al-qurūni allatī musikhat*), a literal doctrine rooted in [Quran 2:65](quran://2/65) and [Quran 7:166](quran://7/166) and reinforced in parallel narrations (`muslim:5043`, `muslim:5044`, `bukhari:3305`). His own words ("*lā adrī la'allahu*"—"I do not know; perhaps it is...") demonstrate that he treated the folkloric notion that living reptiles might be transformed humans as a genuine biological possibility.

muslim:5833.note: When 'Abdullah b. 'Umar ordered a snake killed, Abu Lubaba al-Ansari testified that he heard Muhammad forbid killing snakes found in houses (*al-jinnān*) except for short-tailed (*al-abtar*) and two-streaked (*dhā al-ṭufyatayn*) snakes, declaring that both snatch away eyesight and affect what is in the wombs of pregnant women.

problematic_excerpt.arabic: قَالَ كَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ يَوْمًا عِنْدَ هَدْمٍ لَهُ فَرَأَى وَبِيصَ جَانٍّ فَقَالَ اتَّبِعُوا هَذَا الْجَانَّ فَاقْتُلُوهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو لُبَابَةَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ قَتْلِ الْجِنَّانِ الَّتِي تَكُونُ فِي الْبُيُوتِ إِلاَّ الأَبْتَرَ وَذَا الطُّفْيَتَيْنِ فَإِنَّهُمَا اللَّذَانِ يَخْطِفَانِ الْبَصَرَ وَيَتَتَبَّعَانِ مَا فِي بُطُونِ النِّسَاءِ ‏.‏
problematic_excerpt.english: as 'Abdullah b. 'Umar saw one day (standing) near the ruin (of his house) the slough of a snake and said (to the people around him):Pursue this snake and kill it. Abu Lubaba Ansari said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He forbade the killing of snakes found in the houses except the short-tailed snakes and those having streaks upon them, for both of them obliterate eyesight and affect that which is in the wombs of (pregnant) women

muslim:5833.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that this warning describes the physical effects of snake venom or the sudden fright a pregnant woman experiences upon seeing a snake, rather than a belief that certain snakes inherently obliterate vision and cause miscarriage. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states that Allah's Messenger forbade killing snakes found in houses (*al-jinnān allatī takūnu fī al-buyūt*, الْجِنَّانِ الَّتِي تَكُونُ فِي الْبُيُوتِ) except for the short-tailed (*al-abtar*, الأَبْتَرَ) and two-streaked (*dhā al-ṭufyatayn*, ذَا الطُّفْيَتَيْنِ) snakes, declaring that 'both of them snatch away eyesight and pursue what is in the wombs of women' (فَإِنَّهُمَا اللَّذَانِ يَخْطِفَانِ الْبَصَرَ وَيَتَتَبَّعَانِ مَا فِي بُطُونِ النِّسَاءِ). Reinforced by the parallel narrations in `bukhari:3297`, `bukhari:3298`, and `muslim:5832`, the verbs *yakhṭifāni* (snatch away) and *yatatabbaʿāni* (pursue) attribute direct, targeted action to these specific varieties rather than describing a general startle response.

muslim:1817.note: When told of a man who slept through the entire night until morning, Muhammad declares that Satan urinated in his ears (or ear) (cf. bukhari:1144, bukhari:3270). Classical commentators—including Qadi 'Iyad, al-Qurtubi, and Ibn Hajar—affirm that taking Satan's urination literally ('ala haqiqatihi) is a primary orthodox position alongside metaphorical interpretations.

problematic_excerpt.arabic: ذُكِرَ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلٌ نَامَ لَيْلَةً حَتَّى أَصْبَحَ قَالَ ‏"‏ ذَاكَ رَجُلٌ بَالَ الشَّيْطَانُ فِي أُذُنَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ قَالَ ‏"‏ فِي أُذُنِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
problematic_excerpt.english: Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) reported that a mention was made of a man who slept the whole night till morning. He (the Holy Prophet) remarked:That is a man in whose ears (or in whose ear) the devil urinated

muslim:1817.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that Satan urinating in a sleeper's ears is merely a figurative idiom (majāz or kināyah) symbolizing spiritual heedlessness and Satan's contempt for one who sleeps through prayer. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states بَالَ الشَّيْطَانُ فِي أُذُنَيْهِ أَوْ قَالَ فِي أُذُنِهِ ('the devil urinated in his two ears—or he said: in his ear'), preserving a literal anatomical count that makes a purely metaphorical reading untenable. Furthermore, leading Sunni commentators including Al-Nawawī (Sharḥ Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim), Al-Qāḍī ʿIyāḍ, and Ibn Ḥajar (Fatḥ al-Bārī on Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 1144) affirm the orthodox position that Satan's urination is real and literal (ʿalā ḥaqīqatihi), matching parallel Ṣaḥīḥ traditions where Satan physically sleeps in human nostrils, eats, and passes gas.

bukhari:278.note: Muhammad states that a stone ran away with Moses's clothes while he was bathing so the Israelites would see him naked and verify he did not have a scrotal hernia, after which Moses took his garment and beat the stone—an episode Muhammad cites in a parallel report (bukhari:3404) to explain Qur'an 33:69. Abu Huraira adds under oath that Moses's beating left six or seven physical scars on the rock.

problematic_excerpt.arabic: فَذَهَبَ مَرَّةً يَغْتَسِلُ، فَوَضَعَ ثَوْبَهُ عَلَى حَجَرٍ، فَفَرَّ الْحَجَرُ بِثَوْبِهِ، فَخَرَجَ مُوسَى فِي إِثْرِهِ يَقُولُ ثَوْبِي يَا حَجَرُ‏.‏ حَتَّى نَظَرَتْ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ إِلَى مُوسَى، فَقَالُوا وَاللَّهِ مَا بِمُوسَى مِنْ بَأْسٍ‏.‏ وَأَخَذَ ثَوْبَهُ، فَطَفِقَ بِالْحَجَرِ ضَرْبًا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ وَاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَنَدَبٌ بِالْحَجَرِ سِتَّةٌ أَوْ سَبْعَةٌ ضَرْبًا بِالْحَجَرِ
problematic_excerpt.english: So once Moses went out to take a bath and put his clothes over a stone and then that stone ran away with his clothes. Moses followed that stone saying, "My clothes, O stone! My clothes, O stone! till the people of Bani Israel saw him and said, 'By Allah, Moses has got no defect in his body. Moses took his clothes and began to beat the stone." Abu Huraira added, "By Allah! There are still six or seven marks present on the stone from that excessive beating

bukhari:278.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that the fleeing stone was either a metaphor for rushing water or a dignified divine miracle (mu'jizah) ordained to clear Moses of the physical defect alleged by the Israelites in Quran 33:69. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states that a literal rock fled with his garment (fa-farra al-ḥajaru bi-thawbihi), that Moses shouted directly at the stone (thawbī yā ḥajaru), and that he beat it so violently that it retained six or seven physical scars (nadab)—details that classical commentators like Al-Nawawī and Ibn Hajar cite to reject any metaphorical reading. Furthermore, parallel narration bukhari:3404 explicitly ties this incident to Quran 33:69, reducing Moses's Quranic exoneration to an absurd folkloric spectacle in which Allah vindicates a prophet's modesty by forcing him to sprint naked in public so the Israelites can inspect his genitals.

muslim:6133.note: Muhammad declares that every newborn infant cries out at birth (*yastahillu ṣārikhan*) because Satan pricks it (*nakhasahu al-shayṭān*), exempting only the son of Mary and his mother. Abū Hurayrah grounds this physical exemption in the maternal prayer of protection recorded in [Quran 3:36](quran://3/36) (cf. bukhari:3286, muslim:6134).

problematic_excerpt.arabic: مَا مِنْ مَوْلُودٍ يُولَدُ إِلاَّ نَخَسَهُ الشَّيْطَانُ فَيَسْتَهِلُّ صَارِخًا مِنْ نَخْسَةِ الشَّيْطَانِ إِلاَّ ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ اقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ ‏{‏ وَإِنِّي أُعِيذُهَا بِكَ وَذُرِّيَّتَهَا مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ‏}‏
problematic_excerpt.english: No child is born but he is pricked by the satan and he begins to weep because of the pricking of the satan except the son of Mary and his mother. Abu Huraira then said: You may recite if you so like (the verse):" I seek Thy protection for her and her offspring against satan the accursed" (iii)

muslim:6133.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that Satan's pricking (*nakhsat al-shayṭān*) is merely a spiritual metaphor for entering a world of temptation rather than a literal physical cause for a newborn's first cry. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states that the infant begins to scream directly because of Satan's pricking (*fa-yastahillu ṣārikhan min nakhsati al-shayṭān*), establishing a direct causal link between a demonic poke and neonatal crying from which only the son of Mary and his mother were protected ([Quran 3:36](quran://3/36)).

muslim:6133.category: Christian Doctrines Muslims Attack That Are Conceded in Hadith
muslim:6133.subcategory: Uncreated Divine Word, Original Sin & Sacramental Relics (Trinitarian & Soteriological Precedents)
muslim:6133.note: While Islamic polemics reject Original Sin ([Psalm 51:5](bible://ps/51/5), [Romans 5:12](bible://rom/5/12)) and claim all prophets share equal protection, Muhammad states with a universal negation (*mā min mawlūdin yūladu*) and an exclusive exception (*illā ibna Maryama wa ummahu*) that every newborn child is pricked by Satan at birth except the son of Mary and his mother ([Luke 1:35](bible://lk/1/35), [Hebrews 4:15](bible://heb/4/15)). Abū Hurayrah anchors this unique exemption directly in the maternal prayer of [Quran 3:36](quran://3/36) ([Ibn Kathir 3:36](ibnkathir://3/36), cf. bukhari:3286).

problematic_excerpt.arabic: مَا مِنْ مَوْلُودٍ يُولَدُ إِلاَّ نَخَسَهُ الشَّيْطَانُ فَيَسْتَهِلُّ صَارِخًا مِنْ نَخْسَةِ الشَّيْطَانِ إِلاَّ ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ اقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ ‏{‏ وَإِنِّي أُعِيذُهَا بِكَ وَذُرِّيَّتَهَا مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ‏}‏
problematic_excerpt.english: No child is born but he is pricked by the satan and he begins to weep because of the pricking of the satan except the son of Mary and his mother. Abu Huraira then said: You may recite if you so like (the verse):" I seek Thy protection for her and her offspring against satan the accursed" (iii)

muslim:6133.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that Satan's touch at birth signifies only an external desire to mislead rather than a universal human condition, and claim that all prophets—including Muhammad—share the same immunity as Jesus. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states a universal rule with an exclusive exception—"No child is born but he is pricked by the satan... except the son of Mary and his mother" (*mā min mawlūdin yūladu illā nakhasahu al-shayṭān... illā ibna maryama wa-ummahu*)—which leaves Muhammad subject to Satan's touch at birth while uniquely conceding the sinless purity of Christ ([Hebrews 4:15](bible://heb/4/15), [Quran 3:36](quran://3/36)).

bukhari:3359.note: Muhammad orders the killing of geckos (al-wazagh), declaring that the creature used to blow on the fire against Abraham. Classical commentators such as Ibn Hajar and Al-Nawawi affirm this literal command and explicitly accept that the creature's ancestor blew on Abraham's fire as a reason for killing the species.

problematic_excerpt.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَ بِقَتْلِ الْوَزَغِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ كَانَ يَنْفُخُ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ ‏"‏‏.‏
problematic_excerpt.english: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered that the salamander should be killed and said, "It (i.e. the salamander) blew (the fire) on Abraham

bukhari:3359.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that the command to kill geckos (*al-wazagh*) is merely a practical hygiene measure against domestic pests, claiming the reference to Abraham's fire is either symbolic or merely illustrates an innately noxious nature (*fuwaysiq*) as discussed by Al-Nawawī and Ibn Ḥajar in *Fatḥ al-Bārī*. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states the ancient folkloric act as the direct justification for the slaughter (*amara bi-qatli al-wazagh wa-qāla: kāna yanfukhu ʿalā Ibrāhīm*—'He ordered the killing of the gecko and said: It used to blow on Abraham'), while parallel narrations in *Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim* (`muslim:5844`) award up to a hundred religious good deeds (*ḥasanāt*) for crushing one on the first strike. Awarding spiritual merit for exterminating an entire reptile species over what its ancestor allegedly did millennia ago proves this is superstitious collective punishment rather than sanitation, directly violating the Quran's own maxim that no soul bears the burden of another (Surah 6:164).

muslim:564.note: Muhammad commands anyone waking from sleep to flush and blow their nose three times (`falyastanthir thalatha marratin`), declaring that Satan spends the night in the upper nasal cavity (`khayashimihi`). Classical commentators such as al-Nawawi and Qadi 'Iyad affirm that this is to be understood literally (`'ala zahirihi`), as the prescribed physical remedy of flushing the nostrils with water three times precludes a purely metaphorical reading.

problematic_excerpt.arabic: إِذَا اسْتَيْقَظَ أَحَدُكُمْ مِنْ مَنَامِهِ فَلْيَسْتَنْثِرْ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَبِيتُ عَلَى خَيَاشِيمِهِ
problematic_excerpt.english: When any one of you awakes up from sleep and performs ablution, he must clean his nose three times, for the devil spends the night in the interior of his nose

muslim:564.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that "the devil" (*al-Shayṭān*) here is merely a metaphor for nocturnal dust, dried mucus, or microscopic germs that cause sluggishness upon waking, occasionally appealing to secondary figurative (*majāz*) suggestions recorded by Qāḍī ʿIyāḍ. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states that *al-Shayṭān yabītu ʿalā khayāshīmihi* ("Satan spends the night in his upper nasal passages") and prescribes a physical expulsion via *istinthār* (blowing water out of the nostrils three times), leading both Al-Nawawī (*Sharḥ Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim*) and Ibn Ḥajar (*Fatḥ al-Bārī* on `bukhari:3295`) to rule that the statement must be taken literally (*ʿalā ẓāhirihi*) as an actual demon lodging inside the nose. This literal 7th-century AD demonology is cemented by parallel Sahih narrations where Satan physically urinates into the ears of anyone who sleeps through prayer (`bukhari:1144`) and loudly passes wind to drown out the call to prayer (`muslim:856`).

muslim:6134.note: This narration transmitted through Al-Zuhri states that Satan touches a newborn child at the time of birth, causing the infant to begin crying out because of Satan's touch.

problematic_excerpt.arabic: وَقَالاَ ‏"‏ يَمَسُّهُ حِينَ يُولَدُ فَيَسْتَهِلُّ صَارِخًا مِنْ مَسَّةِ الشَّيْطَانِ إِيَّاهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ شُعَيْبٍ ‏"‏ مِنْ مَسِّ الشَّيْطَانِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
problematic_excerpt.english: " The newborn child is touched by the satan (when he comes in the world) and he starts crying because of the touch of satan." In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Shu'aib there is a slight variation of wording

muslim:6134.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that Satan's touch at birth is merely a metaphor for a human being's future susceptibility to temptation rather than the literal cause of a newborn's first cry. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states that Satan touches the child at the time it is born (*yamassuhu ḥīna yūladu*), causing it to start crying out directly because of that touch (*fayastahillu ṣārikhan min massati al-shayṭāni iyyāhu*). Reinforced by parallel narrations (muslim:6133, muslim:6135, bukhari:3286, bukhari:3431, bukhari:4548) linked to [Quran 3:36](quran://3/36), the report presents an infant's physical cry at birth as the immediate result of Satan's touch (*min massi al-shayṭāni*).

bukhari:3308.note: Muhammad commands the killing of the two-striped snake (dhū al-ṭufyatayn), declaring that it snatches away eyesight and causes pregnant women to miscarry (see also bukhari:3297, muslim:5832).

problematic_excerpt.arabic: اقْتُلُوا ذَا الطُّفْيَتَيْنِ، فَإِنَّهُ يَلْتَمِسُ الْبَصَرَ، وَيُصِيبُ الْحَبَلَ
problematic_excerpt.english: Kill the snake with two white lines on its back, for it blinds the on-looker and causes abortion

bukhari:3308.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that this narration describes spitting cobras spraying venom into a victim's eyes and pregnant women miscarrying from the natural psychological shock of seeing a serpent. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states that the two-striped snake (*dhū al-ṭufyatayn*) 'seeks out the sight and strikes the pregnancy' (*yaltamisu al-baṣara wa-yuṣību al-ḥabal*), which classical authorities like Ibn Hajar in *Fatḥ al-Bārī* and Al-Nawawī in *Sharḥ Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim* confirm meant its mere gaze or appearance supernaturally snatches away human vision and aborts fetuses on contact. Furthermore, two-striped snakes in the Arabian Peninsula are non-spitting species, exposing this decree as ancient basilisk folklore rather than medical science.

muslim:1007.note: Muhammad states that he went at night with an inviter from the Jinn to recite the Quran to them, shows his companions the traces of the Jinn's tracks and fires, and declares that every bone over which Allah's name was mentioned becomes covered with meat again when it falls into the Jinn's hands while animal dung serves as fodder for their beasts. On this basis, he forbids Muslims from wiping themselves after defecation (*istinja'*) with either bones or dung because they are the food of their Jinn brothers.

problematic_excerpt.arabic: فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَتَانِي دَاعِي الْجِنِّ فَذَهَبْتُ مَعَهُ فَقَرَأْتُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقُرْآنَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَانْطَلَقَ بِنَا فَأَرَانَا آثَارَهُمْ وَآثَارَ نِيرَانِهِمْ وَسَأَلُوهُ الزَّادَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَكُمْ كُلُّ عَظْمٍ ذُكِرَ اسْمُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ يَقَعُ فِي أَيْدِيكُمْ أَوْفَرَ مَا يَكُونُ لَحْمًا وَكُلُّ بَعَرَةٍ عَلَفٌ لِدَوَابِّكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَلاَ تَسْتَنْجُوا بِهِمَا فَإِنَّهُمَا طَعَامُ إِخْوَانِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
problematic_excerpt.english: He (the Holy Prophet) said: There came to me an inviter on behalf of the Jinn and I went along with him and recited to them the Qur'an. He (the narrator) said: He then went along with us and showed us their traces and traces of their embers. They (the Jinn) asked him (the Holy Prophet) about their provision and he said: Every bone on which the name of Allah is recited is your provision. The time it will fall in your hand it would be covered with flesh, and the dung of (the camels) is fodder for your animals. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Don't perform istinja with these (things) for these are the food of your brothers (Jinn)

muslim:1007.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that prohibiting the use of bones and dung for wiping after defecation (*istinjāʾ*) is a prescient rule of medical hygiene to prevent bacterial infection, or that the Jinn only absorb an unseen, metaphysical essence from them. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states that the sole reason for the prohibition is that these items are "the food of your brothers" (*fa-innahumā ṭaʿāmu ikhwānikum*), specifying that when a bone falls into the Jinn's hands (*yaqaʿu fī aydīkum*), it becomes covered with "as much meat as it ever had" (*awfara mā yakūnu laḥman*) while dung serves as fodder for their beasts (*ʿalafun li-dawābbikum*). As Al-Nawawī confirms in *Sharḥ Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim*, classical orthodoxy holds that Allah literally recreates flesh on the bone for the Jinn to eat, proving the taboo is rooted in seventh-century AD Arabian demonology rather than germ theory.

muslim:1267.note: Muhammad states that whenever the call to prayer (adhan) is pronounced, Satan turns and flees while loudly breaking wind (lahu durat) so that he cannot hear the call, before returning after the second call (tathwib) to whisper distractions until a worshipper forgets how much he has prayed. Classical commentators such as al-Nawawi and Ibn Hajar note that the primary Sunni position takes Satan's audible flatulence literally as a physical sound emitted to drown out the call to prayer.

problematic_excerpt.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا نُودِيَ بِالأَذَانِ أَدْبَرَ الشَّيْطَانُ لَهُ ضُرَاطٌ حَتَّى لاَ يَسْمَعَ الأَذَانَ فَإِذَا قُضِيَ الأَذَانُ أَقْبَلَ فَإِذَا ثُوِّبَ بِهَا أَدْبَرَ فَإِذَا قُضِيَ التَّثْوِيبُ أَقْبَلَ يَخْطُرُ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَنَفْسِهِ يَقُولُ اذْكُرْ كَذَا اذْكُرْ كَذَا ‏.‏ لِمَا لَمْ يَكُنْ يَذْكُرُ حَتَّى يَظَلَّ الرَّجُلُ إِنْ يَدْرِي كَمْ صَلَّى
problematic_excerpt.english: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When there is a call to prayer the devil runs back breaking the wind so that he may not hear the call, and when the call is complete he comes back. And when the takbir is pronounced he again runs back, and when takbir is over he comes back and distracts a man saying: Remember such and such, remember such and such, referring to something the man did not have in his mind. with the result that he does not know how much he has prayed

muslim:1267.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that the phrase 'breaking wind' (lahu ḍurāṭ) is merely a figurative Arabic idiom expressing intense panic and humiliation during flight rather than literal flatulence. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states the functional, acoustic purpose of the act—'so that he may not hear the Adhan' (ḥattā lā yasmaʿa al-adhān)—proving that Satan is emitting a literal, loud noise to drown out the call to prayer. Consequently, classical commentators like Al-Nawawī (Sharḥ Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim) and Ibn Ḥajar (Fatḥ al-Bārī) affirm that this flatulence is to be taken literally (ʿalā ẓāhirihi) as an actual sound produced by a physical body, which is further corroborated by parallel Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim narrations specifying that he flees an exact physical distance of thirty-six miles to al-Rawḥāʾ.

muslim:6136.note: Muhammad states via Abu Huraira that the crying of a newborn infant at the moment of delivery is caused by a prick from Satan (cf. bukhari:3286, bukhari:3431, muslim:6133).

problematic_excerpt.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ صِيَاحُ الْمَوْلُودِ حِينَ يَقَعُ نَزْغَةٌ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
problematic_excerpt.english: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The crying of the child (starts) when the satan begins to prick him

muslim:6136.anticipated_defense: Muslim apologists typically argue that Satan pricking the newborn is a metaphor for the child entering a world of spiritual trial rather than a literal cause for why babies cry at birth. However, the primary Arabic text explicitly states that the crying of the newborn at the moment of delivery (ṣiyāḥu al-mawlūdi ḥīna yaqaʿu) is a prick from Satan (nazghatun mina al-shayṭān). Rather than using figurative language, this report and its parallel narrations in bukhari:3286, bukhari:3431, and muslim:6133 directly attribute the physical act of an infant's birth cry to demonic contact.

bukhari:1144.note: When told of a man who slept until morning without rising for prayer, Muhammad declares that Satan urinated in his ear (see also bukhari:3270, muslim:1817).
